notes: FTP research centers on anonymous access, cleartext credentials, and version-specific CVEs (e.g. vsftpd/ProFTPD). Treat anonymous access and credential exposure as distinct states.

checks.title: Anonymous FTP access
checks.validation: Attempt an anonymous banner/login check once with approval; list only, do not download en masse. Classify as anonymous access, not 'no auth'.

checks.title: Cleartext credentials in transit
checks.when: plain FTP (not FTPS) is in use
checks.validation: Note that captured traffic would expose credentials; recommend FTPS. No action against the target required.

checks.title: Writable FTP root
checks.when: upload is permitted (often combined with a web root)
checks.validation: Check write permission non-destructively with approval; a writable web-served directory can lead to RCE.
